scope_note: Sources align the contract with vtree-based knowledge compilation, structured decomposability and decomposition selection. They do not prove that a polynomial candidate portfolio always contains a polynomial vtree.

sources.title: SDD: A New Canonical Representation of Propositional Knowledge Bases
sources.role: Primary source for vtrees and structured decomposition in SDDs.

sources.title: SDDs are Exponentially More Succinct than OBDDs
sources.role: Primary context for the representational importance of recursive vtree structure relative to one linear order.

sources.title: Knowledge Compilation, Width and Quantification
sources.venue: Theory and Applications of Models of Computation 2019 / arXiv:1807.04263
sources.role: Primary context for width-sensitive structured compilation and quantification costs.

sources.title: Discovering Archipelagos of Tractability for Constraint Satisfaction and Counting
sources.role: Primary context for selecting interacting tractable regions rather than treating local tractability as sufficient.
